gates_text.A0_instrument: evidence integrity; zero protected-pool violations; zero applied_without_evaluation; zero architecture-scope violations
gates_text.A1_completion: 100% planned episodes terminal (provider outages are pending, never terminal); evaluation complete

order: S0 zero-API V3.1 oracle readiness of ALL 26 eligible tasks (A, B and reserve) + frozen replacement rule

outcome_tokens.PILOT_A_GENERATOR_FLOOR_HOLD: A2/A3/A5 fail -> HUMAN_DECISION (options: M14R interface probe on DEV_TRAIN_ENG only; never consume Pilot-B tasks)
outcome_tokens.PILOT_A_INSTRUMENT_FIX: A0 or A1 fail -> instrument repair on ENG/synthetic evidence; no new protected outcomes

pilot_a.purpose: Gold-vs-Placebo assay sensitivity + generation variance calibration on the protected holdout; NOT a selector comparison
pilot_a.replicate_cache_policy: one response cache per replicate label; no reuse across replicates or arms

agent_localization.order: all Agent localizations frozen and pushed BEFORE any Pilot-B generation
agent_localization.reason: no frozen Agent selection exists for any holdout task (pool census)
agent_localization.runs: one fresh Agent localization per task per replicate (r1, r2); replicate r uses Agent run r (selector stochasticity is part of the method)

cost_boundary.agent_selector_cost: actual ledger of the M15 Agent localization runs
cost_boundary.headline: selector + generation + repair, provider-reported (ledger)
cost_boundary.rmcss_selector_cost: per-task WP-1 records if present; otherwise the frozen MAIN_297 per-task mean, labeled IMPUTED_FROM_MAIN297

pilot_b.gold_role: within-block reference ceiling on the same tasks
pilot_b.purpose: selector E2E behavior and run-to-run stability; NOT a final ranking and NOT a significance test

rmcss_selection.empty_prediction_rule: NO_SCOPE outcome of the method; never a stop
rmcss_selection.source: final_oof_predictions_A.json (deterministic; same scope for r1 and r2)

research_replicate_rule_after_pilot_b.escalate_to_3_if: for RM-CSS or Agent: endpoint-tuple agreement across r1/r2 < 0.75 OR |resolved_rate_r1 - resolved_rate_r2| > 0.10
